extraction.Name: William Bordeaux, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded August 2, 1918, by the Kilgore State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Bordeaux and wife mortgaged the land January 10, 1919, to Martha G. Snyder for $1000. Foreclosure sale was made August 15, 1927. On August 30, 1925, Bordeaux and wife executed a quit claim deed to E. R. Rusho for $1.00 and other valuable consideration.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 633400 issued; East half of Southeast quarter section 8, township 37, range 25. The receipt for patent was signed by the allottee June 28, 1918. Foreclosure sale made August 15, 1927.
